repo.description: The repository (DID or handle) whose personas to list.

domain.description: Domain slug to filter by (fallback when domainUri unavailable).

kind.description: persona kind slug to filter by (fallback when a kindUri filter is unavailable).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return in one page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response, to resume after the last returned record.

records.description: The page of persona records returned.

cid.description: CID of this persona record at this revision.
